notes.title: Can I ask you for a favour?
notes.content:
I wonder if I could ask you for a favour?

I'm trying to write a business plan so people can take me more seriously in the business sphere. When I got up to the marketing part of the template, I suddenly realised I don't actually know who my players are! So please, could you answer these questions to help me understand a little more? https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/QXTSCJV

I'm hoping that if I can take things further with my development business, we'll have a Wonderland Nights sequel on our hands sooner rather than later!

Thanks :)

notes.title: Her Jentle Hi-ness launches on KickStarter in one week!
notes.content:
Playable demo here!: [url=https://skybeargames.itch.io/her-jentle-hi-ness]https://skybeargames.itch.io/her-jentle-hi-ness[/url]

In Her Jentle Hi-ness, you have to serve a jealous queen who has banned the letter G after being cheated on and abandoned by her consort King George. Playing as the lady-in-waiting Eorina (formerly Georgina), you have to try and survive the mad whims of the queen. Are you fast enough to keep up with her linguistic gymnastics?

How will your story end? Will you just make it out? Will you use the opportunity to rise through the ranks? Or will you die an ignoble death at the end of the executioner’s axe?

On Wednesday 28th July (NZT) the KickStarter campaign launches here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skybeargames/her-jentle-hi-ness-a-linguistically-twisted-visual-novel]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skybeargames/her-jentle-hi-ness-a-linguistically-twisted-visual-novel[/url] but for now you can sign up there to get notified of the launch.

[url=https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzY1NDUwODYuanBn/original/qS14g0.jpg][img]https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzY1NDUwODYuanBn/original/qS14g0.jpg[/img][/url]

There are over 25 different endings to achieve that draw on the dark whimsy of fairytales (25 as it currently stands – more could result from the top tier of this campaign!). These endings result in achievements and an unlockable gallery of over 60 background and ending images!

There are over 15 romanceable options… and counting! At present the word count sits at 25,000, but it’s still rising!

As you can see, the art of Her Jentle Hi-ness spans from zany cartoon characters to classic works of art. The character art is by illustrator and animator Sean Miller (Faylmonkey). His characters evoke the flights of fancy of such cartoons as Adventure Time and Invader Zim, which is why I chose Sean as a collaborator on this project.

The oil paintings, charcoal sketches and other artworks in the backgrounds are all public domain artworks provided by the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York. These works have been given a fun new life by being juxtaposed with the cartoon styles of Sean’s characters. ‘But what does it mean?’ I hear you cry. Well, it can mean whatever you want it to mean! Perhaps it’s about reducing the romaniticism of royalty in fiction through humour? Perhaps the stripped down features of the people speak to the degradation of a people living under an oppressive tyrant? Use your imagination!

The game features an original soundtrack by Michaela Cornelius of Mikatte Music (www.mikattemusic.com) . Along with the quirky sound effects, Michaela’s music blends the elegance of traditional instrumentation with an injection of contrasting modernity to delight the ear.

As the demo currently demonstrates, this game features timed dialogue branches. In the finished game these will be enhanced by the inclusion of difficulty levels to ease in the casual player and challenge the advanced linguistic gymnast.

You will be able to get a sense of the characters and their emotions with short gibberish voice acting, sort of like ‘Simglish’ from The Sims. Providing these voices will be familiar voices from my previous projects: myself, Lauren Wilson, Tom Tobin, and James Dunning.

The estimated release for this game is December 2021.

notes.title: A finalist AGAIN! White Rabbit's Diary is in the Freeplay Awards
notes.content:
Once again, Wonderland Nights: White Rabbit's Diary is a finalist for an award!

This time it is in the 'Across the Ditch Award' Category (for games from NZ) in the ​Freeplay Awards. Check out the amazing list of finalists here: [url=https://www.freeplay.net.au/awards/]https://www.freeplay.net.au/awards/[/url]

We're absolutely stoked to be considered amongst the stunning line-up of games from small indie studios and individuals from Australia and NZ in this list. Congratulations to all our fellow finalists!

​This has really been the year of the Rabbit so far ^_^

notes.title: White Rabbit's a Finalist AGAIN!
notes.content:
Once again, Wonderland Nights: White Rabbit's Diary has been named a Finalist for an award! This time it is the Sir Julius Vogel Award for Best Professional Production/Publication, an award which is given annually by the Science Fiction and Fantasy Association of New Zealand.

We are thrilled to be among the brilliant finalists in this and the other categories, which you can see here: [url=https://sffanz.nz/the-sir-julius-vogel-awards/sir-julius-vogel-award-finalists-2021/]https://sffanz.nz/the-sir-julius-vogel-awards/sir-julius-vogel-award-finalists-2021/[/url]

notes.title: Introducing Wonderland Nights: White Rabbit's Diary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37443553/dfe75d41c39c47c8af756ae9168b87e2e661db05.jpg[/img]

In order to secure a unique trademark for the game formerly known as White Rabbit: Royal Scheduler, allow me to reintroduce you to your old favourite: Wonderland Nights: White Rabbit's Diary!

Why is this happening? Well, watch this space. There will be more news in the coming months of...
- an update coming to Steam! Such as new art, unique achievement images and full voice acting!
- ports to consoles!!
- translations into multiple languages!

The renaming also opens the floodgates to new sequel potentials, and not just for the character of White Rabbit, but for many more characters in Wonderland. Watch this space!
